6 ORAL ARGUMENT OF ANTHONY F. SHELLEY
7 ON BEHALF OF THE PETITIONER
8 MR. SHELLEY: Mr. Chief Justice, and may it
9 please the Court:
10 There are at least three reasons why the
11 Court should adopt what the courts of appeals have
12 called the per­prisoner approach under PLRA
13 Section 1915(b)(2).
14 One, the per­prisoner approach best comports
15 with the statutory text.
16 Two, the per­prisoner approach is the only
17 one consistent with the careful balance Congress struck
18 between deterring frivolous prisoner lawsuits and
19 preserving their right to bring meritorious ones.
20 And three, the per­prisoner approach avoids
21 anomalies and disincentives that Congress could never
22 have intended, disincentives such as discouraging
23 prisoner work by taking one hundred percent of their
24 income month after month.
25 I would like to, of course, start with the
